senses.gloss:
गोतम गोतम, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi be-
longing to the family of Aṅgiras, with the patronymic
Rāhūgaṇa, author of several hymns of the Vedas;
N. of a lawyer; N. of a sage, the founder of the
Nyāya philosophy; N. of the twentieth Vyāsa in
the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa; of a king of Potāla, son of
Karṇika; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Gotama.
—गोतम-स्तोम, अस्, m., N. of an Ekāha sacrifice.
—गोतम-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a Jaina saint; [cf.
गन्तम-स्वामिन्.]
—गोतमान्वय (˚म-अन्˚), अस्,
m. a descendant of Gotama, epithet of Śākya-muni,
the founder of the Buddhist religion.
—गोतमी-
पुत्व, अस्, m., N. of a prince; (also गोमति-पुत्र.)
गोत्र गो-त्र. See under गो, p. 297.
